title: Celsius to Fahrenheit table
prompt: Print a Celsius to Fahrenheit table for 0, 20, 40, 60, 80 and 100 degrees Celsius, one line each, in the form `0C = 32F`. Compute F with whole-number arithmetic: multiply C by 9, divide by 5 (the division is exact for these values) and add 32. Print the results as whole numbers without a decimal point.
